title: Head of Credit / Credit Manager
cardBlurb: Build the credit engine of an AI-native NBFC in the making, from the first policy to launch day.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for our first senior credit leader. You will write the credit policy and risk framework for a planned portfolio of secured and unsecured loans for consumers and businesses (MSMEs), and work with our technology and data teams to turn sound credit judgement into a data-driven decision engine. If you want to design credit the right way, with clean policy, disciplined underwriting and data at the core, and take it from blueprint to launch, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Write the credit policy, risk appetite and product-level credit norms from day zero, designed to meet RBI requirements for NBFCs.
  • Set underwriting standards for secured and unsecured lending to consumers and MSMEs, from borrower and cash-flow assessment to collateral and security.
  • Work with engineering and data teams to translate credit judgement into decision rules, scorecards and workflows, and define where a credit officer must stay in the loop.
  • Design the portfolio monitoring, early-warning, collections and provisioning frameworks the business will run on.
  • Once we are registered and operational, lead underwriting of the early book and build the credit team that scales it.

Who You Are

Proven credit underwriting and policy experience at an NBFC, HFC, bank or fintech lender (6+ years for Credit Manager; more for Head of Credit), across secured and unsecured consumer or MSME lending, with working knowledge of RBI regulation for NBFCs. You can say “no” with data and “yes” with conviction.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Credit – Head / Manager”.

title: Head of Business Development, Sales & Partnerships
cardBlurb: Build the growth engine of an AI-native NBFC in the making: its channels, its partners and its market.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for our first senior growth leader. You will design how we reach customers, which partners we build with and how we scale, creating a partner-led, digitally integrated distribution model for secured and unsecured loans to consumers and businesses (MSMEs), with compliance and credit discipline built in from the start. If you want to design a lender’s distribution the right way and take it from blueprint to a national footprint, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Shape the go-to-market strategy: target segments, geographies, channel mix and customeracquisition economics.
  • Design the channel-partner framework, covering selection, due diligence, onboarding and governance of DSAs, connectors and advisers, in line with RBI outsourcing and digital lending norms.
  • Identify and develop strategic, API-led and embedded-finance partnership opportunities with platforms and ecosystems that serve consumers and MSMEs.
  • Build the sales operating model, incentive design and commission structures that reward quality of book, not just volume.
  • Once we are registered and operational, lead origination, partner activation and the sales and partnerships team.

Who You Are

10–15+ years in business development, sales or partnerships at an NBFC, HFC, bank or fintech lender, including 4–5 years in leadership, with a track record of scaling channel-led origination in consumer or MSME lending. You grow a business by building trust, and you protect it by refusing shortcuts.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Business Development – Head”.

title: Technology Lead – Digital Lending Platform
cardBlurb: Build the technology backbone of an AI-native NBFC in the making, from the first integration to launch and beyond.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for the engineer who will own its lending platform for the long term. You will help architect and integrate an API-first digital lending stack, bringing together a configurable LOS/LMS and specialist partners for KYC, credit bureau, Account Aggregator, eSign, payments and collections, on cloud, code and data owned by Pfundit. You will initially be employed by our managed technology-services partner and work full-time on Pfundit, with the intention of transferring to Pfundit Capital Private Ltd. as Technology Lead after it receives RBI registration and is ready to make direct hires. If you would rather build a regulated lending platform from the ground up than inherit a mature one, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Shape architecture and solution design, translating lending, risk and compliance requirements into clear integration specifications.
  • Lead integration and delivery across the delivery team and third-party providers: sprints, releases and end-to-end testing of the borrower journey.
  • Build security, privacy and auditability in from day one, designed for RBI’s IT, cyber-security and digital lending expectations, including India data residency, least-privilege access, audit logs and VAPT readiness.
  • Prepare the platform for AI and agentic workflows, working with our AI team on data contracts, APIs and workflow events.
  • After transfer, own the technology roadmap, vendor governance and production operations, and build the in-house team.

Who You Are

7–10 years in backend or full-stack engineering, solution architecture or platform operations, with 3–5 years in fintech, NBFC or regulated BFSI. Hands-on with India’s digital lending rails and AWS/DevOps, and pragmatic about buy-versus-build.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Technology Lead – Digital Lending”.
